items.title: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
items.description: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.

items.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
items.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit St Petersburg as Putin's flagship economic forum opens
items.description: Several long-range drones struck oil storage facilities near the city, days before Vladimir Putin is due to address the event.

items.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
items.description: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.

items.title: Shell pumped oil through Nigeria pipeline for years despite pollution evidence, documents show
items.description: The oil giant says the documents ignore the critical context of the complex operating environment at the time.

items.title: Eight killed after drone hits bus in Russia-controlled part of Ukraine
items.description: The bus was travelling between Moscow and Simferopol, in Russian-controlled Crimea, an official says.

items.title: Celine Dion 'heartbroken' by death of Beauty and the Beast singer Peabo Bryson
items.description: Bryson was best known as the voice behind Disney songs like A Whole New World and Beauty and the Beast.

items.title: US announces new tariffs over forced labour concerns
items.description: It comes after the US Supreme Court struck down many of US President Donald Trump's previous duties in February.

items.title: Watch: Man attacked by bear at steel works in Japan
items.description: The bear, which injured four people in the attack on Tuesday, remains on the loose within the factory compound.

items.title: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass advances to run-off in race to run California's biggest city
items.description: The mayor's opponent could be either Republican newcomer and reality TV star Spencer Pratt, or a fellow Democrat, council member Nithya Raman.

items.title: Indonesia's Prabowo fires head of free meals scheme plagued by poisonings
items.description: The centrepiece programme of Prabowo's government has left tens of thousands of school children ill.

items.title: New York police investigate videos of men emerging from city's sewer system
items.description: Authorities warn that entering the sewer system is both illegal and extremely dangerous.
